_about: Source of truth for this file's names, enums and rooms. The tools read it; `npm run check` verifies the .rml against it. `setBy: engineering` properties are the ones engineering may set if they ever drive Rive directly; `setBy: integration` ones only our integration sets. Scene order is the enum order: the index in this list is the value Rive stores.

scene.about: Which room the stage shows. Setting the same value again does nothing.

direction.about: forward for Next, back for Back. Set before scene.

lockup.about: true shows the game lockup, false hides it (anon slides and community cards). Read only while a game's scene is entered.

scenes.name: to-chapter-3
scenes.about: Empty Chapter 3 backdrop: this file's last picture and File 3's first. Our integration passes through it.

scenes.name: from-chapter-1
scenes.about: Empty Chapter 1 room: this file's first picture (its default) and File 1's last.
